# Revista Comunicar

> A peer-reviewed, open-access academic journal publishing research on communication and media studies with multilingual support and rigorous editorial standards.

Revista Comunicar is a leading scientific journal managed through OJS 3 and indexed in major research databases including Web of Science and CrossCheck. The journal maintains high editorial standards through its Grupo Comunicar organization and affiliated training programs for authors and reviewers.
